content.text:
good morning — hope your coffee's still hot.

Mira's 18-month vaccines are coming up in about two weeks, so now's a good time to ring the pediatric office if you haven't scheduled that yet. at this stage it's also lovely to listen for her starting to put two words together — something like "more juice" or "mama up" — just a fun little milestone to keep an ear out for, no pressure.

on the local front, there's a drop-in parent-and-tot swim at the community pool this saturday — could be a nice low-key outing for the whole family, especially with the summer solstice making today the longest day of the year. enjoy it!
